text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O-O-Ooh!? What is this, you two...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday! Fukukitaru! This is the 
"Daikichimaru"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove worked super hard to win this 
for me at the arcade yesterday! Please 
take it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What!? Air Groove-san was!? At an 
arcade!? Trying her absolute hardest!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tch... When you ask me while half in 
tears, how am I supposed to say no?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Air Groove can do ANY-thing! I 
ALWAYS believed you could beat the crane 
game!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
... Should I really have said I could do 
20 reps?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-You went that far... for this little 
one...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru always makes a ruckus with me 
in class, yes! She shouts out loud with 
me, yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So that someone like you can stay 'Great 
Blessing.' ...Apparently, that's what it's 
for.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*sniff* *sniff*... Overflowing gratitude! 
Overwhelming excitement, total good 
fortune-maru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san! Air Groove-san! Let's all dance 
the Happy Great Fortune Wasshoi Ondo 
together next time! ...Along with this 
Daikichimaru!
